question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**crucial**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage emphasizes the importance of effective time management.
 
• The word to fill the blank should convey that time management is essential or necessary for success.
 
• "Crucial" means extremely important or essential, which fits the context perfectly.
 
• The other options do not convey the necessary importance of time management.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Effective time management is (1) **crucial**__ for success. By prioritising tasks, individuals can enhance (2)_____and reduce stress. Planning allows for a balance (3)_____work and personal life. Studies show that those who manage their time (4) _____are more likely to achieve their goals. It is a skill (5)____positively impacts both professional and personal aspects of life.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Trivial** (तुच्छ): "Trivial" means unimportant or of little value, which is the opposite of what the sentence needs.
 
• **Desperate** (निराश): "Desperate" means feeling or showing hopelessness, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Optional** (वैकल्पिक): "Optional" means available to be chosen but not obligatory, which understates the importance of time management.
